DECLARE @lookback_window DATETIME2 = DATEADD(minute, -60, SYSUTCDATETIME());

-- 1. Incremental CDC on fact_environmental_daily
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.fact_environmental_daily', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.fact_environmental_daily AS 
    SELECT * FROM SmartFarming_Lakehouse.gold.fact_environmental_daily;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    MERGE dbo.fact_environmental_daily AS target
    USING (
        SELECT * FROM (
            SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY date_key, facility_key, zone_key ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS _rn
            FROM SmartFarming_Lakehouse.gold.fact_environmental_daily
            WHERE created_timestamp >= @lookback_window
        ) src WHERE _rn = 1
    ) AS source
    ON target.date_key = source.date_key 
       AND target.facility_key = source.facility_key 
       AND target.zone_key = source.zone_key
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
        avg_ambient_temp_celsius = source.avg_ambient_temp_celsius,
        min_ambient_temp_celsius = source.min_ambient_temp_celsius,
        max_ambient_temp_celsius = source.max_ambient_temp_celsius,
        avg_humidity_pct = source.avg_humidity_pct,
        avg_co2_ppm = source.avg_co2_ppm,
        avg_vpd_kpa = source.avg_vpd_kpa,
        avg_temp_drift_celsius = source.avg_temp_drift_celsius,
        avg_stability_score = source.avg_stability_score,
        avg_water_ph = source.avg_water_ph,
        avg_ec_ms_cm = source.avg_ec_ms_cm,
        telemetry_sample_count = source.telemetry_sample_count,
        created_timestamp = source.created_timestamp
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
        date_key, facility_key, zone_key, avg_ambient_temp_celsius,
        min_ambient_temp_celsius, max_ambient_temp_celsius, avg_humidity_pct,
        avg_co2_ppm, avg_vpd_kpa, avg_temp_drift_celsius, avg_stability_score,
        avg_water_ph, avg_ec_ms_cm, telemetry_sample_count, created_timestamp, pipeline_run_date
    )
    VALUES (
        source.date_key, source.facility_key, source.zone_key, source.avg_ambient_temp_celsius,
        source.min_ambient_temp_celsius, source.max_ambient_temp_celsius, source.avg_humidity_pct,
        source.avg_co2_ppm, source.avg_vpd_kpa, source.avg_temp_drift_celsius, source.avg_stability_score,
        source.avg_water_ph, source.avg_ec_ms_cm, source.telemetry_sample_count, source.created_timestamp, source.pipeline_run_date
    );
END;
